title_en: Moso the Mole Who Loves Digging
page_text_ocr_zh:
爱打洞的鼹鼠莫索
ài dǎ dòng de yǎn shǔ mò suǒ
page_text_en:
The Mole Who Loves Digging Holes
ài dǎ dòng de yǎn shǔ mò suǒ
summary_zh: 本页为绘本标题页，展示书名《爱打洞的鼹鼠莫索》。

title_en: Moso the Mole Who Loves Digging
page_text_ocr_zh:
有 一 只 小 鼹 鼠 叫 莫 索。
他 最 爱 在 地 下 摸 索 着 打 洞。
地下很暗，什么也看不见，小鼹鼠
总是凭着自己的感觉，往东、往南、
往西、往北打着洞。
每当他把洞挖出了地面，他都会
跑出地洞，瞧瞧四周美丽的风景，吸一口新鲜的空气，这是他最快活、最享受
的时候。
要是在洞外正巧有一棵苹果树，
或者是梨树，就更好了。掉在地上的
苹果和梨，能让他饱餐一顿，他还能挑
几个好的，带进洞里。这时的莫索，是
全世界最快活的鼹鼠。
page_text_en:
There is a little mole named Moso.
He loves digging tunnels underground.
Underground is very dark, and he can't see anything, so the little mole
always digs east, south, west, and north, relying on his own sense.
Whenever he digs his tunnel out to the surface, he will
run out of the hole, look at the beautiful scenery around, take a breath of fresh air, and this is when he is happiest and most content.
If there happens to be an apple tree outside the hole,
or even better, a pear tree, the apples and pears that have fallen to the ground
will let him have a big meal, and he can even pick
a few good ones to bring back into the hole. At this moment, Moso is
the happiest mole in the whole world.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了主角小鼹鼠莫索，描述了他喜欢在地下摸索打洞，并在挖出地面后享受新鲜空气和风景，如果遇到苹果或梨树，他还能饱餐一顿，是全世界最快活的鼹鼠。

title_en: Moso the Mole Who Loves Digging
page_text_ocr_zh:
不过，在地下打洞，有时是很冒险的。有一次，他把洞打到了狐狸的家里。狐狸饿着肚子，正发愁没有东西下锅，小鼹鼠差点儿让狐狸逮住，丢进汤锅里。

还有一次，他把洞打到了一只黑熊的洞里。黑熊怒气冲天，尽管小鼹鼠莫索连连说对不起，并保证把洞口重新填上，但是黑熊还是伸出手，给了小鼹鼠重重一巴掌。

幸好小鼹鼠躲得快，那巴掌落在离他一点点远的地方，就像发生了一场地震，震得洞顶的泥土直往下掉，小鼹鼠抱着脑袋赶快逃走了……
page_text_en:
But digging underground can sometimes be very dangerous. Once, he dug his tunnel right into the fox's home. The fox was hungry and worried about having nothing to cook. The little mole almost got caught and thrown into the pot.

Another time, he dug into a black bear's cave. The bear was furious. Even though the little mole Moso kept apologizing and promised to refill the tunnel entrance, the bear still reached out and gave the mole a hard slap.

Luckily, the mole dodged quickly. The slap landed just a little bit away from him, like an earthquake, shaking the cave ceiling and making dirt fall down. The little mole clutched his head and ran away quickly...
summary_zh: 本页讲述了小鼹鼠莫索在地下打洞时遇到的两次危险经历：一次差点被饿肚子的狐狸抓住，另一次被愤怒的黑熊打了一巴掌，最后侥幸逃脱。

title_en: Moso the Mole Who Loves Digging
page_text_ocr_zh:
有一天，小鼹鼠莫索打洞的时候，在洞外草地上意外地发现一只大蘑菇。小鼹鼠采下蘑菇，把它拖进洞口。他想再打个洞，或许能挖出一条离他家最近的道，好快点把大蘑菇运回家。

可是他挖了没多远，只听见扑哧一声响，小鼹鼠已经把脑袋伸进了田鼠巫婆的家。
田鼠巫婆正坐在一把古老的摇椅上，在灯下读着她的魔法书。小鼹鼠吓坏了，连连说：“对不起，对不起，打扰了，我不是有意的……”

为了向田鼠巫婆表示歉意，小鼹鼠把那只大蘑菇留给了田鼠巫婆，并用最快的速度，把刚才挖出的洞口填
page_text_en:
One day, while digging, little mole Moso unexpectedly found a big mushroom on the grass outside his tunnel. He picked the mushroom and dragged it into the tunnel entrance. He thought of digging another tunnel, perhaps to find a path closest to his home, so he could quickly bring the big mushroom back.

But he hadn't dug far when, with a pfft sound, his head had already poked into the home of the mole witch.
The mole witch was sitting on an old rocking chair, reading her magic book by the lamp. The little mole was frightened and kept saying, “I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I didn’t mean to…”

To apologize to the mole witch, the little mole left the big mushroom with her, and then quickly filled in the tunnel entrance he had just dug.
summary_zh: 小鼹鼠莫索在挖洞时意外发现一只大蘑菇，正想运回家时，不小心把头伸进了田鼠巫婆的家，吓坏了巫婆。为了道歉，他把蘑菇留给巫婆，并迅速填平了洞口。

title_en: Moso the Mole Who Loves Digging
page_text_ocr_zh:
上了。
可是小鼹鼠刚一转身，刚被填
上的洞又被打开了，田鼠巫婆走了过
来说：“对不起，我也打扰你一下！”
田鼠巫婆来到小鼹鼠莫索身边，
说：“你是一只讲礼貌、很懂规矩的小
鼹鼠，我不能白要你的蘑菇。”
说着，她轻轻念动咒语，摸了摸小
鼹鼠莫索毛茸茸的小脑袋，说：“去吧，
勤劳的、懂礼貌的小鼹鼠，你会更愉快
的！”
page_text_en:
It was over.
But just as the little mole turned around, the hole that had just been filled was opened again. The field mouse witch walked over and said, "I'm sorry, I'll bother you a little too!"
The field mouse witch came to the little mole Moso's side and said, "You are a polite and well-behaved little mole. I can't take your mushroom for free."
Then, she softly chanted a spell, patted the little mole Moso's fluffy little head, and said, "Go on, hardworking and polite little mole, you will be even happier!"
summary_zh: 田鼠巫婆因小鼹鼠莫索意外闯入她的家而受惊，莫索道歉并留下蘑菇后离开。巫婆被莫索的礼貌打动，念咒语祝福他，希望他更加快乐。

title_en: Moso the Mole Who Loves Digging
page_text_ocr_zh:
从此，小鼹鼠莫索有了一个特别的本领，他可以一边挖洞，一边竖起耳朵听、拱起鼻子闻，假如他听到不远处有兔子在说笑，或者闻到黑熊在烤玉米饼的味道，就知道前面有人家，他会很快转个方向，这样就不会打扰别人了。
要是听到不远处有泉水叮咚、树叶沙沙响，或者闻到野花和果子的香味，洞外一定有美丽的风景……
每当鼹鼠莫索在洞外享受风景、吃着甜甜的果子时，他都会说：“我要谢谢田鼠巫婆，我不会忘记讲礼貌、懂规矩带给我的好处！”
page_text_en:
From then on, little mole Moso had a special skill. He could dig tunnels while lifting his ears to listen and sniffing with his nose. If he heard rabbits laughing nearby or smelled black bears roasting corn cakes, he knew there was a home ahead and would quickly change direction so as not to disturb others.
If he heard the tinkling of spring water or rustling leaves, or smelled the fragrance of wildflowers and fruits, he knew there must be beautiful scenery outside the tunnel...
Whenever Moso enjoyed the scenery and sweet fruits outside the tunnel, he would say, "I want to thank the field mouse witch. I will never forget the benefits of being polite and following the rules!"
summary_zh: 小鼹鼠莫索学会了在挖洞时通过听和闻来判断周围环境，避免打扰他人，并在享受洞外风景和果子时，感谢田鼠巫婆教给他的礼貌与规矩。
